title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
description: Anthropic launched a startup program offering a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in token credits. The offer is aimed at early-stage companies building on Claude.

title: Mistral's new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
description: Mistral introduced a new one-trillion-parameter model that it positions as outperforming both closed and open competitors. The release raises the bar for open-weight frontier models.

title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT's text in the EU
description: OpenAI will begin applying digital watermarks to text generated by ChatGPT for users in the European Union. The move comes as EU rules on labeling AI-generated content take effect.

title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
description: AI cloud and computing provider Lambda is reportedly raising $4 billion ahead of a planned IPO. The round reflects continued investor appetite for AI infrastructure.

title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
description: Autonomous AI agents increasingly run into websites that block or restrict automated access. The piece examines the permission and access frameworks that may be needed for agents to operate on the web.

title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
description: Hark released a new AI personal assistant that makes user data protection a core feature. It joins a growing field of personal-agent products.

title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
description: Former Ramp engineers raised $20 million for their new platform Melius after abandoning their original product. The article covers the pivot and the startup's new direction.
